partnerRequired: You need to bring a partner
partnerHint: Partnered dancing does not necessarily mean you need to bring a partner.
prerequisitesHint: Describe specific skills, not just how long someone has danced.
repeatHint: 2–520 sessions, at the same local time. All dates are created when you save.
seriesRsvp: Your RSVP applies to the whole series, not to an individual class.
editSeries: Schedule changes apply to future dates. Past dates, individual moves, cancellations and participant answers are preserved. Removing a date cancels it.
intensityHint: Effort and music speed are different. Describe both so dancers can choose what suits them.

homeIntro: Discover Lindy Hop and solo jazz classes, workshops and socials in your city. Choose your level and pace, meet dancers and share your own events.
regularText: Regular classes. Familiar faces. Your own pace.
soloText: Solo jazz, footwork and improvisation. No partner required.
partnerText: Lindy Hop and the joy of connecting on the dance floor.
workshopText: Workshops, masterclasses and intensives for your next discovery.
socialText: Social dancing, live music and a community to come back to.
tempoText: Choose your style, level and energy. Combine as many filters as you need.
beginnerText: Find beginner-friendly classes and check whether you need a partner.
hostText: Create an event or make an announcement people can save and share.
